title: On Achieving the first real result
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：achieve　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 achieve 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the planner ① achieved the first real result without complaint, and every citizen in the district said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the planner ② achieves the first real result with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ achieve the first real result at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ achieved the first real result before — a line in the report for March 1969 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Achieving the first real result without complaint, the planner said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the plan at the far square, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ achieve a place of their own with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Achieve a place of their own at once and never mention it again.

By 1982 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the report, and a new citizen from the next district ⑧ achieves a place of their own without complaint every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the square, said nothing at all; she simply  achieved the first real result again when nobody else would.

To achieve the first real result, my mother said in 1987, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the district remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the district forgets, somebody achieves the first real result with great care again and somebody must achieve the first real result without complaint all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 实现（一般过去式 achieved the first real result：1975 年规划员头一回这样做，毫无怨言地）
B. v. 实现（一般现在 achieves the first real result：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 实现（不定式 to achieve the first real result：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 实现（过去完成时 had achieved the first real result：1969 年三月的规划报告上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 实现（动名词 achieving the first real result 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 取得（achieve a place of their own：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去取得属于他们自己的位置）
G. v. 取得（achieve a place of their own：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 实现（后段两处：新来的市民照例 achieves a place of their own，而母亲又一次 achieved the first real result）

items.q: to achieve the first real result
achieved the first real result before
achieve a place of their own with great care
achieve a place of their own at once
achieves a place of their own without complaint

answers.why: achieve 意为“实现”，1975 年规划员毫无怨言地实现头一个真正的成果，那是街区里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 achieved。
achieve 意为“实现”，自那以后规划员小心翼翼地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 achieves。
achieve 意为“实现”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯实现头一个真正的成果”，此处为不定式 to achieve the first real result。
achieve 意为“实现”，规划报告里 三月 那行字说明早在 1982 年之前就有人实现过，故用过去完成时 had achieved。
achieve 意为“实现”，规划员说“实现头一个真正的成果这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 achieving the first real result 作主语。
achieve 意为“取得”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去取得属于他们自己的位置”，should ever 之后用原形 achieve a place of their own。
achieve 意为“取得”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻取得属于他们自己的位置（achieve a place of their own at once），以后再也不要提起。
achieve 意为“实现”，新来的市民每个年份都照例取得属于他们自己的位置，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 achieves。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1975 年，规划员毫无怨言地实现头一个真正的成果；街区里每一个市民都说这是头一回。（achieved the first real result）
多年以后，规划员仍小心翼翼地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（achieves the first real result）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯实现头一个真正的成果这件事本身。（to achieve the first real result）
早在 1969 年就有人实现头一个真正的成果，三月那天规划报告上的一行字就是证据。（had achieved the first real result）
规划员说过，毫无怨言地实现头一个真正的成果这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（achieving the first real result 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻取得属于他们自己的位置，以后再也不要提起。（achieve a place of their own，祈使句）
answers: In 1975 the planner achieved the first real result without complaint, and every citizen in the district said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three years on, the planner still achieves the first real result with great care without being asked.
My mother said later that to achieve the first real result at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had achieved the first real result long before 1982, and the line in the report for March proves it.
Achieving the first real result without complaint, the planner said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Achieve a place of their own at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 achieve 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1975 the planner achieved the first real result without complaint, and nobody in the district forgot it.
Even now the planner achieves the first real result with great care whenever the district asks.
Achieving the first real result without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever achieve a place of their own with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new citizen from the next district achieves a place of their own without complaint every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother achieved the first real result again, and the district remembered that half.
